units.source_en: Prince Doran shared his secret smile with her.
“From Lys.
A great fleet has put in there to take on water.
Volantene ships chiefly, carrying an army.
No word as to who they are, or where they might be bound.
There was talk of elephants.”
“No dragons?”

paragraphs.source_en: “Elephants. Easy enough to hide a young dragon in a big cog’s hold, though. Daenerys is most vulnerable at sea. If I were her, I would keep myself and my intentions hidden as long as I could, so I might take King’s Landing unawares.”
